description: Source code for a PDF document loader component in a larger software project, implementing the INode interface, with methods for initializing and extracting documents from PDF files, supporting options like text splitting, metadata handling, and legacy PDF parsing.

classes.name: Pdf_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing a PDF file loader node, capable of loading and processing PDF documents with options for text splitting, metadata, and legacy PDF parsing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, loads PDF files from storage or base64, processes metadata, and returns documents or concatenated text based on configuration.

methods.name: extractDocs
methods.description: Helper method to load and split PDF documents using PDFLoader, supporting perFile or perPage usage modes, with optional text splitting.
